label.en: LAMBDA location updates and satellite images

_comment: Test scenario for LAMBDA. Two queries: the newest location_update items from the sources ankle_bracelet and gps_location (one layer per source; drawn from their own location.point), and images from the source "EO optical (fictional)" (the Syria convoy demo, with locations) in a layer named "Satellite". recent_days, limit and layer are read by hl/items.py and not sent to HL API; APP_ITEMS_PER_TYPE overrides limit. No location entities exist on LAMBDA, so the Location layer stays empty.
